e.summary_en: This Visual Studio Code extension **brings risk management and compliance inside Azure DevOps**, stating verbatim that it integrates them directly into the platform and that risks are identified and managed end to end through a risk register, a risk matrix and risk metrics. **Measured this round**: version 1.0.265, last updated at the end of August, nineteen installs, a five-star rating, and a publisher described as a Swedish company. **This entry belongs to the round theme of the editor plugin marketplace, and of what is actually there under insurance keywords.** **Four things are worth reading: it treats three artefacts — the risk register, the risk matrix and risk metrics — as one job, namely keeping a risk ledger inside the development platform; it lists the regulations and standards it claims to simplify, from European digital and cyber resilience rules and two ISO standards through privacy regulation to financial reporting and audit acts, and among them the digital operational resilience regulation applies directly to insurers, although this remains a general governance tool rather than an insurance-specific one; the version number itself carries information, since a three-part version in the two hundreds indicates very frequent releases, which contrasts with the single-release pattern common in this marketplace; and it records no repository, with a licence link pointing at the publisher knowledge base and only nineteen installs, a sample far too small to support any quality judgement.** **The extension was not installed or tried this round.**
e.body:
**Nooga Risk**（VS Code 扩展 `nooga.nooga-risk`）**是一个**把**风险管理与合规**做进 **Azure DevOps** 的**编辑器插件****——**逐字自述为**「**Integrate risk management and compliance directly into Azure DevOps. Identify and manage risks end-to-end with a risk register, risk matrix, and risk metrics.**」**，**并**逐字续**「**Simplify compliance with regulations and standards such as CRA, DORA, NIS2, ISO 27001, ISO 31000, GDPR, NIST, SEC, SOX.**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**编辑器插件市场：保险关键词下到底有什么**」**。

**可核实信息（均 VS Code 市场接口与其自带说明实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它把三件风险物件写成一件事****——**⭐ 本次实测**其说明逐字含**「**risk register, risk matrix, and risk metrics**」**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**值得记**：**⭐ 即**在**研发平台里**维护**风险台账**，**意味着**风险条目**与**代码、**工单**处在**同一个系统**里**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**这**正是**「**治理要贴住**工作发生的地方**」**的一个**具体做法**（**⭐ 与本会话**多次记下的**「**把口径写进**工具**」**同向**）**。**⭐⭐ ② 法规清单被逐字列出，**而**其中一条**与保险业**直接相关****——**⭐ 本次实测**其说明逐字列出**：**`CRA`、**`DORA`、**`NIS2`、**`ISO 27001`、**`ISO 31000`、**`GDPR`、**`NIST`、**`SEC`** 与 **`SOX`****；**⭐ 本词条**如实指出**：**⭐ **`DORA`（**数字运营韧性）**的**适用范围**包含**保险与**再保险机构****，**故**这条**对**保险业的**合规工作**有**直接关系**；**⭐ 但**本词条**同时**明确标注**：**这**仍是一个**通用治理工具**，**不是**保险专用**，**也**未核实**其**对**任何**具体法规条款**的**覆盖**是否**完整**。**⭐⭐ ③ 版本号本身就是信息****——**⭐ 本次实测**其版本逐字为 **`1.0.265`****；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**值得记**：**⭐ 即**三段式版本号**走到 **265****，**说明**它**发布**极频繁**（**⭐ 可能是**持续集成**直接发版**）**——**⭐ 而**本轮**同批**多条**保险相关插件**的版本号**还停在 **`0.0.x`／**`0.2.2`／**`1.1.x`****，**⭐ 两相对照**可以**看出**发布节奏**的**差别**。**⭐⭐ ④ ⚠️ 可核查性与样本量**都须如实标注****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**元数据里**没有**源码仓库地址**；**许可链接逐字指向**发布方的**知识库**（**`https://knowledge.nooga.net/knowledge-base`**）**；**安装量 **19 次**、**评分 **5****；**⭐ 其**资产清单**含 **`dist/Admin/Admin.html`** 与**打包后的 **JS／**CSS****——**⭐ 即**它**是一个**自带界面的**真插件**，**而**不是**一个**只有清单的**壳**。**⭐ 本词条**据此**如实指出**：**⭐ 19 次安装**与**5 分评分**的**样本量**太小**，**不能**据此**判断**其质量或**可靠性**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[insurance-governance]]、**[[iso-42001-toolkit]]、**[[governance-mcp]]、**[[continuous-monitoring-ai-risk]]、**[[osfi-ai-risk-controls]] 与**[[frai]] 覆盖**治理、**风险控制与**合规工具链**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**把**风险台账**与**指标**搬进**研发平台**的**编辑器插件**，**且**其**法规清单**含**与**保险业相关的 **DORA**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 本条最值得借的四件事**：**① **治理**要**贴住**工作发生的地方**（**本条为**研发平台**）**；**② **法规清单**要**逐条列出**，**而**不是**写一句「**符合监管**」**；**③ **版本号**与**发布节奏**可以**作为**项目活跃度的**旁证**；**④ **安装量很小**时**要**明确说明**，**不要**让**评分**暗示**质量**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有安装、**没有试用**该扩展**（**未建立任何风险登记簿、**未生成任何指标**）**，**故**不主张**其功能可用**、**不主张**其**对任何法规的**覆盖**是否**完整或准确**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**市场接口返回的**元数据**与**其自带的**说明**（**未读**其**打包后的**代码**）**。**③ ⚠️ **未核实**其**与**任何**监管要求**的对应关系**（**⭐ 本词条**只记录**其自述的**法规清单**）**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其**与**保险行业的**任何**客户或**案例**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**其**数据存放位置**（**⭐ 合规工具的**数据位置**本身**是**使用前**必须弄清的一处**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ **19 次安装**与**5 分评分**样本极小**，**本词条**不据此**作任何质量判断**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**该插件**不是**合规认证**，**也**不能**替代**持牌顾问或**监管沟通**。

Identify and manage risks end-to-end with a risk register, risk matrix, and risk metrics.**」**，**並逐字續**「**Simplify compliance with regulations and standards such as CRA, DORA, NIS2, ISO 27001, ISO 31000, GDPR, NIST, SEC, SOX.**」**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**編輯器外掛市場：保險關鍵詞下到底有什麼**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 VS Code 市場介面與其自帶說明實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它把三件風險物件寫成**一件事****——**說明逐字含 risk register, risk matrix, and risk metrics****；**⭐ 即**在研發平台裡維護風險台賬**，**意味著**風險條目與代碼、**工單處在同一個系統裡**——**⭐ 這正是「**治理要貼住工作發生的地方**」的具體做法**。**⭐⭐ ② 法規清單被逐字列出，**而其中一條與保險業直接相關****——**逐字列出 `CRA`、`DORA`、`NIS2`、`ISO 27001`、`ISO 31000`、`GDPR`、`NIST`、`SEC`、`SOX`****；**⭐ `DORA`（**數字運營韌性）**的適用範圍**包含**保險與再保險機構**；**⭐ 但**這仍是通用治理工具**，**不是保險專用**，**也未核實**其對任何具體條款的覆蓋是否完整**。**⭐⭐ ③ 版本號本身就是資訊****——**版本逐字為 `1.0.265`****——**⭐ 即**它發布極頻繁**；**⭐ 而**本輪同批多條保險相關外掛的版本號還停在 `0.0.x`／`0.2.2`／`1.1.x`**。**⭐⭐ ④ ⚠️ 可核查性與樣本量都須如實標註****——**元資料裡沒有源碼倉庫位址**；**許可連結逐字指向 `https://knowledge.nooga.net/knowledge-base`**；**安裝量 19 次、**評分 5****；**資產清單含 `dist/Admin/Admin.html` 與打包後的 JS／CSS**——**⭐ 即**它是**一個自帶介面的真外掛**；**⭐ 但**19 次安裝樣本太小**，**不能據此判斷質量**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 與池內條目的關係**：[[insurance-governance]]、[[iso-42001-toolkit]]、[[governance-mcp]]、[[continuous-monitoring-ai-risk]]、[[osfi-ai-risk-controls]]、[[frai]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**把風險台賬與指標搬進研發平台的編輯器外掛，**且其法規清單含與保險業相關的 DORA**」這一形態**。

**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 四件事值得借**：**① **治理要貼住工作發生的地方**；**② **法規清單要逐條列出**；**③ **版本號可作活躍度旁證**；**④ **安裝量很小時要明確說明**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有安裝、**沒有試用**該擴充**，**不主張**其功能可用**，**也不主張**其對任何法規的覆蓋是否完整或準確**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只讀市場介面返回的元資料與其自帶說明**（**未讀**打包後的代碼**）**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實**其與任何監管要求的對應關係**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實**其與保險行業的任何客戶或案例**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實**其數據存放位置**。**⑥ ⚠️ 19 次安裝與 5 分評分樣本極小**，**不據此作任何質量判斷**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 該外掛不是合規認證**。

e.body_en:
This Visual Studio Code extension **brings risk management and compliance inside Azure DevOps**, stating verbatim that it integrates them directly into the platform, that risks are identified and managed end to end through a risk register, a risk matrix and risk metrics, and that it simplifies compliance with a named list of regulations and standards. **This entry belongs to the round theme of the editor plugin marketplace, and of what is actually there under insurance keywords.**

**Verified information, all measured from the marketplace interface and the text the extension ships**: **first, it treats three risk artefacts as one job.** The description names a risk register, a risk matrix and risk metrics together. **Keeping a risk ledger inside the development platform means risk entries live in the same system as code and work items, which is a concrete instance of the principle that governance should sit where the work happens, and it echoes the pattern recorded repeatedly in this session of putting definitions inside the tools.** **Second, the regulation list is written out, and one entry applies directly to insurers.** The description names the European cyber resilience act, the digital operational resilience act, the network and information security directive, two ISO standards covering information security and risk management, the privacy regulation, a United States standards framework, and the financial reporting and audit acts. **The digital operational resilience regulation applies to insurance and reinsurance undertakings, so that line has a direct bearing on insurance compliance work, but this entry also states plainly that the extension remains a general governance tool rather than an insurance-specific one, and that its coverage of any particular provision was not verified.** **Third, the version number is itself information**: it reads 1.0.265, **which indicates very frequent releases, probably straight from continuous integration, and contrasts with the other insurance-related plugins seen this round whose versions remain at 0.0.x, 0.2.2 or 1.1.x.** **Fourth, verifiability and sample size must be stated plainly**: no repository is recorded, the licence link points at the publisher knowledge base, installs stand at nineteen with a five-star rating, and the asset list includes an administrative page and bundled scripts and styles, **so it is a real plugin with a bundled interface rather than an empty listing, while nineteen installs is far too small a sample for any quality judgement.** **Fifth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover insurance governance, an AI management system toolkit, a governance protocol, continuous risk monitoring and control frameworks, **while this entry supplies an editor plugin that moves risk ledgers and metrics into a development platform and names a regulation that applies to insurers. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **four practices transfer: put governance where the work happens; list regulations one by one rather than claiming compliance in general; treat version numbers and release cadence as evidence of activity; and state explicitly when install counts are tiny, so that a rating does not imply quality.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the extension was neither installed nor tried**, so no risk register was created and no metrics were produced, **and no claim is made that it works or that its coverage of any regulation is complete or accurate**. **Second, only the marketplace metadata and the description it ships were read, not the bundled code.** **Third, its correspondence with any regulatory requirement was not verified**, only the list of regulations it claims to address being recorded. **Fourth, any customers or cases in the insurance industry were not verified. Fifth, where it stores data was not verified**, which is a question that must be settled before using any compliance tool. **Sixth, with nineteen installs and a five-star rating the sample is far too small for any quality judgement, and none is offered. Seventh, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that the plugin is not a compliance certification and cannot replace licensed advice or regulatory dialogue.**
